proposal.reason: Primary change is in network transport/proxy: NET/CollNet backend selection moved to per-communicator state, plugin init/finalize is per-comm, and proxy posting/progress/shutdown behavior is updated. communicator also needs review because init/free/split now own backend config/reference lifetime and enforce parent-child backend compatibility for shared resources. device-topology and graph-search need review because EIC/PXN path/build and graph comparison decisions now key off communicator-selected backend state instead of prior global NET state.
